film.title: The Comet of Dessie
film.logline: A seven-year-old in Dessie builds a football from socks and string, kicks it into the fog in a 4–4 match, and never finds it; his grandmother tells him what comets are for.

film.intent: Leave them smiling at their own childhood and proud to say where they are from.
